verdict.rationale: Penpot publishes a pricing page (penpot.dev/pricing), but the evidence shows only generic plan perks: unlimited teams, no file limits within storage capacity, and community plugins. Nothing in the pack shows how seats, tiers, or AI features are broken down, so a buyer cannot confirm the story's core clarity elements. Missing for 10: documented seat types and per-seat pricing, named plan tiers with price points, AI-feature gating by plan, independent corroboration of pricing clarity.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement

citations.quote: Unlimited Teams - Collaborate freely with unlimited teams.
No file limits - Create as many as you need within your storage capacity.
Use community plugins or build your own.
